title: Server upload route
description: A bounded PNG upload handler using the workspace SDK.

sections.title: Integrate with your backend
paragraphs: The userId argument must come from your trusted authentication middleware, never from a form field. Configure per-user quotas and CSRF protection in that layer. Use a server runtime with a request timeout long enough for conversion.
This example leaves accepted jobs to the one-hour retention policy. For resumable jobs or immediate deletion, use createJob and persist the job ID against your application user.

sections.title: Send a selected file
paragraphs: Run this from your form handler with a File from an input element. Do not add a convrt key to this request.

sections.title: Before using this in an application
paragraphs: Run the example with a small synthetic input first, using a server whose engines support the chosen route. Set CONVRT_API_URL to your server origin and load CONVRT_API_KEY from the environment. Keep the key out of browser code and committed configuration.
Choose an output directory appropriate for private files. A successful conversion does not imply that the result is safe to publish; your application decides who can access it and when to delete it.
